dog.description_text:
Hi! I just arrived from Georgia with my siblings! I am currently being fostered on my own. I am working on peepee pad training. Have already learned sit and loveeee cuddling. Would be better in a family that either has someone that WFH or isn't away from the house for long periods of time. Also idea place would be a home with a backyard.
Personality & Characteristics: Playful, Cuddly, energetic
My foster dog is good with: (Dogs, Kids, Cats)
My foster dog is: (Crate trained, working on being House trained, Low shed)
3 Keywords for your pup:
Energy Level (energy): 7
Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: Inbetween( barks when hears noise outside)
Walking Manners: indoor puppy
Appetite: lovesss food
Favorite Things: food, playing, people
Commands/Tricks: Sit!

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it’s a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs.

Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
